vuln_statements.explanation: This loop iterates up to ts->ts_final_idx without proper bounds validation against IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES constant. When ts->ts_final_idx exceeds the maximum allowed rates, this allows out-of-bounds array access when accessing info->status.rates[i] or similar arrays, potentially leading to memory corruption or information disclosure.

This statement accesses the rates array using index i from the unbounded loop. Without proper bounds checking, when ts->ts_final_idx exceeds IEEE80211_TX_MAX_RATES, this causes out-of-bounds read/write access to the rates array, which is the direct manifestation of the vulnerability.
